messages.body_plain:
Both

pData(mySample)$diagnosis <- diagnosis

and

mySampel$diagnosis <- diagnosis

should work, since the latter is a shortcut for the former.

However, pData(mySample$diagnosis) doesn't make sense and shouldn't do anything.

-Kyle

messages.subject: Re: ImzML missing x,y
messages.body_plain:
Hi Greg,

This may be possible using the latest version on Github (1.3.0) which has experimental support for larger-than-memory-datasets. You can install that version directly from Github (the link is on the cardinalmsi.org <http://cardinalmsi.org> website) using install_github from the devtools package. Sorry the Bioconductor version isn't updated with this yet.

Using that version, you could then do something like:

data <- readMSIData("path/to/data.imzML", attach.only=TRUE)
data <- data[,coord(data)$z == 1]
iData(data) <- iData(data)[]

The first line parses the imzML file metadata but doesn't read in the whole binary data file. The second line subsets the data, still without reading it all. The third line forces the subsetted part of the dataset to be read and loaded into memory.

Hopefully this may work for you. It is still experimental.

-Kyle
